# Yahya Quran Academy

> A children's Quran site in Arabic and English: the full Uthmani text with
> verified teaching recitations, illustrated stories from the Quran, and the
> Seerah of the Prophet Muhammad told for ages 6-11. Every page is available
> in both languages at the same URL; append ?lang=en for English.

Non-commercial and educational. No automated mastery score is shown and no
stage unlocks on its own — a parent judges the child's recitation.

## Quran reader
- [The reader](https://yahyaquran.com/read): all 114 surahs in the Uthmani text, each with
  a verified teaching recitation. Individual surahs are at https://yahyaquran.com/read/1
  through https://yahyaquran.com/read/114.

## Stories from the Quran
- [Animals in the Quran — حيوانات في القرآن](https://yahyaquran.com/stories/animals): 8 stories. Eight stories about animals the Quran names, and what they teach.
- [Women in the Quran — نساء في القرآن](https://yahyaquran.com/stories/women): 8 stories. Inspiring examples of patience, faith, and wisdom from Quranic stories.
- [Stories of the Prophets — قصص الأنبياء](https://yahyaquran.com/stories/prophets): 17 stories. Seventeen stories from Adam to Muhammad.
- [People and Nations — شخصيات وأمم](https://yahyaquran.com/stories/nations): 9 stories. Nine stories about the nations and figures the Quran names, and what became of them.

## Seerah of the Prophet
- [Beginnings — Seeds of Light](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah#station-1): 5 stories. Five stories from the childhood of the Prophet (pbuh): his birth, his years in the desert, the love of his grandfather and uncle, and the first work of his life.
- [The Truthful, The Trustworthy](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah#station-2): 5 stories. Five stories from his youth before the revelation: his honesty in trade, his home with Khadijah, his wisdom over the Black Stone, his stand with the wronged, and his retreats to the cave of Hira.
